book_publication: Qualitative prospective protocol and explicit unexecuted scope; no new quantitative headline.

claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins, original Git-bound inputs, exact resumable output copies and saved-only audit/recovery are tracked. The new fact question routes directly to the saved verifier. Actual current-input binding and fixture execution remain separately owned pending legs, never counted as complete.
claim_legs.falsify: Changed profile/case identity, scope/kind, native source/event witnesses and numeric-index types reject; altered retention/verdict/liveness/recovery contracts reject; missing or repeated predecessor-root domains reject.
claim_legs.rederive: The original event-stack selector agrees with independent source ownership and archived event-position reconstruction. Original observer source is authenticated before protocol review; every original cleanup scope has a profile-owned representative.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal hooks must pass before this slice is committed.
new_fact_question: how are genuine omitted release closes selected?
scope: Pure retained-evidence selection and observer protocol only. No new fixture, omitted close, original producer/main, compiler, native process or collector. Actual omissions, final release applicability, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain separately gated.
